fr_html: Le PRESIDENT demande si M. Fernandes est présent et, comme celui-ci est absent, le Président ajoute que le Comité aurait sans doute consenti à l'entendre.
en_html: The PRESIDENT asked if M. Fernandes was present and, as he was not, added that if he had been, the Committee would probably have agreed to hear him.
